identity.name: Aquanaut
identity.one_liner: The jumbo 42.2mm Aquanaut in white gold, launched for the model's 20th anniversary.

narrative.story: For the Aquanaut's 20th anniversary in 2017, Patek scaled the case to 42.2mm and cast it in white gold — the first white gold Aquanaut. The night-blue 5168G-001 came first; the khaki green 5168G-010 followed in 2019 and pushed the 'luxury tool watch in gold' idea further than the collection had gone before.
narrative.collector_notes: White gold reads as steel from across a table, which cuts both ways on resale. Green-strap wear shows fast; the khaki dial shifts noticeably between lighting conditions.
